text: The EFS hand-over harness is a suite in the wave 2 integration pack; it runs in SIT for the run of record and in UAT for the acceptance run against the published contracts, replaces each fake as its I story lands, seeds the synthetic accounts, the EFS action rows, the ACE batch rows and the parameter rows through the owning contracts, and its evidence is a per-run report keyed by story and business date; the run passes only when every owned criterion passes; the case-list, case-timeline and data-quality composite routes and their merge order belong to the platform edge story RWB-PLT-N001-CON.
why: The sources fix the owners, the operations, the events and every legacy value but give no harness repository or environments, no seeding, no evidence format or retention, no pass/fail gate and no composite route path or merge order, and the run cannot wait for a decision.
read: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-10, DP-18 and DP-19, R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 15, 20 and 44; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 11 and 16; legacy RWB-E2-001 sections 3, 12 and 13
confirm: Integration lead and QA lead at the wave 2 entry check
impact: The harness runs on the section 12.8 fakes from Day 1 and proves the hand-over journey across the six services before the I stories land; only the real-service cut-over, the composite route read and the evidence sign-off wait for the confirmation.
